facts.text: The Framingham State Tuition Promise guarantees that admitted Massachusetts undergraduate students with household incomes of $85,000 or less pay zero in tuition and fees after financial aid grants.

sources.title: Start Your College Journey with Confidence - Framingham State University
sources.quote: The Framingham State Tuition Promise guarantees any admitted Massachusetts undergraduate student whose household income is $85,000 or less will pay zero in tuition and fees after applying their financial aid grants.
